newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 14-day, overnight repos.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 14-day, overnight repos.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system via a round of overnight and 14-day fixed-system repurchase agreements, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York confirmed.

The Fed intervened at about 0950 EST/1450 GMT, before its normal 1030 EST/1530 GMT intervention time. A spokesman for the New York Fed said "from time to time they do go in earlier than normal" but the open market desk was just responding to the current money market situation.
Analysts said that by doing 14-day fixed-system RPs, the Fed had obviated the need to perform a coupon "pass," or permanent injection of reserves into the banking system for the time being.
They also noted that the add need was larger due to quarter-end pressures.
